title: Stealthy-Chest-Locks
description: Key-based chest locking for Minecraft servers, with lock types, player keys, admin tools, and a lockpicking minigame.
body:
# Stealthy Chest Locks

Stealthy Chest Locks adds physical key-based locking for Minecraft servers.

Players can lock **chests and doors**, then use an actual in-game key item to unlock them. This makes storage and base protection feel more immersive than simple command-only protection.

## Features

- Lock chests and doors
- Physical key items for players
- Different lock types
- Player-owned locks
- Admin management tools
- Lockpicking minigame
- Useful for survival, factions, roleplay, and event servers
- Simple setup for staff and server owners

## Useful Commands

- `/lock` - Lock the chest or door you are looking at
- `/unlock` - Unlock the chest or door you own
- `/key` - Create or manage a key for your lock
- `/lockpick` - Start lockpicking a locked chest or door
- `/locks` - View your current locked blocks
- `/lockadmin` - Staff/admin management command
- `/lockreload` - Reload the plugin configuration

## How to set up in-game

1. Craft or receive a lock item.
2. Hold the lock in your hand.
3. Right-click a chest, barrel, or door to lock it.
4. The player gets a physical key for that lock.
5. To open the locked block, hold the correct key and right-click it.
6. To remove your lock, look at it and run `/lock remove`.

## Crafting

Locks are crafted using the matching ingot type:

- Copper Lock: copper ingots
- Iron Lock: iron ingots
- Gold Lock: gold ingots
- Lockpick: stick + iron nugget

## Player Commands

- `/lock info` - Check the lock you are looking at
- `/lock remove` - Remove your own lock
- `/lock give-key <player>` - Give another player a copy of your key
- `/lock list` - View your active locks

## Admin Commands

- `/lockadmin give <player> <copper|iron|gold>` - Give a lock item
- `/lockadmin givelockpick <player> [amount]` - Give lockpicks
- `/lockadmin inspect` - Inspect the lock you are looking at
- `/lockadmin remove` - Remove the lock you are looking at
- `/lockadmin removeall <player>` - Remove all locks owned by a player
- `/lockadmin bypass` - Toggle admin bypass mode
- `/lockadmin stats` - Show total active locks

## Crafting Recipes

### Copper Lock

Used for basic locking on chests, barrels, and doors.

```text
┌──────┬──────┬──────┐
│  🟧  │  🟧  │  🟧  │
├──────┼──────┼──────┤
│  🟧  │      │  🟧  │
├──────┼──────┼──────┤
│      │  🟧  │      │
└──────┴──────┴──────┘
🟧 = Copper Ingot

┌──────┬──────┬──────┐
│  ⬜  │  ⬜  │  ⬜  │
├──────┼──────┼──────┤
│  ⬜  │      │  ⬜  │
├──────┼──────┼──────┤
│      │  ⬜  │      │
└──────┴──────┴──────┘
⬜ = Iron Ingot


┌──────┬──────┬──────┐
│  🟨  │  🟨  │  🟨  │
├──────┼──────┼──────┤
│  🟨  │      │  🟨  │
├──────┼──────┼──────┤
│      │  🟨  │      │
└──────┴──────┴──────┘
🟨 = Gold Ingot

┌──────┬──────┬─────────────┐
│      │      │ Iron Nugget │
├──────┼──────┼─────────────┤
│      │Stick │             │
├──────┼──────┼─────────────┤
│      │      │             │

**Keys are not crafted.
****A key is created when a player locks a chest, barrel, or door.**
